name: Skandagiri
highlights: Famous pre-dawn trek to catch a sunrise above the clouds, with ruins of a hill fort near the summit.

name: Nandi Hills
highlights: Popular hill station with Tipu's fort, viewpoints and a motorable road; the trek up Nandi steps is a local favourite.

historicalNote.text: Famous fortified hill, 4,851 feet high, in the west of Kolar District, Mysore, It is the highest point in the east of the State and lies at the termination of a range of hills running north to Penukonda and the Bellary District of Madras.

name: Makalidurga
highlights: Hill-fort trek reached by walking along a railway track, with a Nandi temple at the summit.

name: Devarayanadurga
highlights: Forested hill near Tumakuru with the Yoga Narasimha and Bhoga Narasimha temples and the Namada Chilume spring.

name: Madhugiri Betta
highlights: Among the largest monoliths in Asia; a steep climb with fort walls and railings on the exposed upper rock face.

name: Shivagange
highlights: Cone-shaped sacred hill with temples, a Nandi statue and the Olakal Teertha crevice along the climb.

name: Avalabetta
highlights: Short climb to a dramatic cliff-edge viewpoint with a small temple and a cantilevered rock ledge.
